name: Alexandra Roseingrave
original_name: アレクサンドラ ロージングレイヴ
source:
A young looking tsundere and a genius mage. She is [url=/c12620]Ilmi's[/url] best and only friend, so she can be overprotective of her. 

While she's very skilled in her craft, she can become very clumsy and mess things up at the most important moments. 

[Based on the [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet_pro/grodere/character.html]official description[/url]]
